name: CTAO
summary: Next-generation Cherenkov observatory with northern and southern sites. Dark matter is a core fundamental-physics objective; precursor telescopes must be distinguished from the complete array.
detection_principle: Telescopes of different apertures stereoscopically image atmospheric showers, improving gamma-ray searches through greater effective area and better background separation.
technologies: Large-, medium- and small-sized imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes

status.label: Under construction
status.evidence: The Swiss authority's 2025 page states that construction has begun and telescopes are expected to enter service progressively from 2027; this forecast is not an acceptance milestone.

timeline.event: Construction began, according to the responsible authority

collaboration.name: CTAO collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

key_parameters.name: Overall plan
key_parameters.value: More than 60 telescopes across two sites; the detailed configuration may evolve

phases.name: Precursors / individual telescope delivery
phases.description: Some telescopes have already taken data; this does not imply completion of the entire array

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
